reason: The gap addresses an important aspect of maternal health care utilization, which is known to influence pregnancy outcomes and infant health but has not been specifically studied in relation to Sudden Unexpected Infant Death (SUID). This comparison could provide insights into whether inadequate prenatal care is a risk factor for SUID. The design aims to compare the prevalence of low prenatal healthcare utilization between SUID cases and a representative sample of live births, which can refine our understanding of potential modifiable risk factors.
